open_points.subject: A01 rule 4 equal-submission semantics
open_points.text: `canonical_values` owns “A01 rules 1 and 4,” but its capabilities only compute canonical bytes, identities, value fit and highest class, and it “must not own where a value is stored”; A01 rule 4 instead requires finding an existing stored record, returning it unchanged, preserving its first author and time, and not making it current again.
open_points.question: Which module owns the stateful no-op semantics when an equal contract version, implementation, trial case, flow version or stored value is submitted?
options: Each domain module owns the behavior for its records and uses `store` for atomic lookup/insertion
`store` owns one generic content-record get-or-insert operation and reports whether the record already existed
`canonical_values` owns the behavior and is allowed to depend on persistence
open_points.default_guess: Assign the submission behavior to each domain module, backed by an atomic content-identity lookup/insertion capability in `store`; leave `canonical_values` responsible only for canonicalization and identity computation.
